scientific_queries.note: Third cross-dataset attempt, this time at the pair level on BATCHIE.

subagent_note: None dispatched: the round changes the unit of analysis rather than the model, and a third independent design lands on the same verdict.

what_this_adds.third_distinct_design: key-level raw viability saturated (R86); key-level residual had identity anti-predicting (R105); pair-level residual has both arms anti-correlating (this round)
what_this_adds.arena_has_no_positive_signal: identity's Spearman rho on the pair-level target is -0.165, so even the gate that the arena must carry positive signal fails
what_this_adds.consequence: C78 is confirmed across three arenas and three units, so the 'cannot replicate' verdict no longer rests on a single design

caveat_that_stays: the negative rho matches the R105 signature and may again be a modelling artefact from ridge overfitting 23 compounds; either way it blocks the cross-dataset test, so the promotion verdict is unchanged
limits: only 1,301 pairs with 274 on the test side
the residual target still depends on the additive-null specification
only 10 layouts contributed, the rest having fewer than four cells
retrospective; no mechanism, clinical or drug-choice claim; no meta-learning or RSI
next_gates: the cross-dataset route is now formally closed: three arenas, three units, same failure shape; only a new resource with neither saturation nor anti-prediction could reopen it
